# JJ API Cheatsheet

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-cheatsheet.js from the published type declarations.
     Do not edit by hand: run `npm run build`. -->

One line per public member, with the exact signature. Use it to confirm that a method
exists and to check its parameters before reaching for `.ref` — see `ref-gap.md` for
the native APIs that have no JJ equivalent.

Every mutating method returns `this`, so calls chain.

- `static from(ref: Document): JJD` — Creates a JJD instance from a Document reference.

### `JJE`

Wraps a DOM Element (which is a descendant of Node).

Members declared on this class:

- `addClass(...classNames: string[]): this` — Adds one or more classes to the Element.
- `addClasses(classNames: string[]): this` — Adds multiple classes from an array of class names.
- `closest<W extends JJE<Element> = JJHE<HTMLElement>>(selector: string): W | null` — Finds the closest ancestor (or self) that matches a CSS selector.
- `disable(): this` — Disables the Element by setting the `disabled` attribute and `aria-disabled="true"`.
- `enable(): this` — Enables the Element by removing the `disabled` and `aria-disabled` attributes.
- `getAriaAttr(name: string): string | null` — Gets the value of an ARIA attribute.
- `getAttr(name: string): string | null` — Gets the value of an attribute.
- `getClass(): string | null` — Gets the class attribute.
- `getHTML(): string` — Gets the inner HTML of the Element.
- `getShadow(required: true): JJSR` — Gets a wrapper around the Element's Shadow Root, if it exists. _(+1 overload)_
- `getText(): string` — Gets the text content of the Element.
- `hasAriaAttr(name: string): boolean` — Checks if an ARIA attribute exists.
- `hasAttr(name: string): boolean` — Checks if an attribute exists.
- `hasClass(className: string): boolean` — Checks if the Element has a specific class.
- `hide(): this` — Hides the Element by setting the `hidden` attribute and `aria-hidden="true"`.
- `initShadow(template: TemplateSource, ...styles: string | CSSStyleSheet[]): this` — Initializes an already-attached Shadow DOM with template content and optional styles.
- `rmAriaAttr(...names: string[]): this` — Removes one or more ARIA attributes from the Element.
- `rmAttr(...names: string[]): this` — Removes one or more attributes from the Element.
- `rmClass(...classNames: string[]): this` — Removes one or more classes from the Element.
- `rmClasses(classNames: string[]): this` — Removes multiple classes from an array of class names.
- `setAriaAttr(name: string, value: unknown): this` — Sets a single ARIA attribute on the Element, or removes it when the value is nullish.
- `setAriaAttrs(attributes?: Record<string, unknown> | null): this` — Sets multiple ARIA attributes from an object, or no-ops for nullish input.
- `setAttr(name: string, value: unknown): this` — Sets a single attribute on the Element, or removes it when the value is nullish.
- `setAttrs(attributes?: Record<string, unknown> | null): this` — Sets multiple attributes from an object, or no-ops for nullish input.
- `setClass(className: string): this` — Sets the class attribute.
- `setClasses(classMap?: Record<string, unknown> | null): this` — Conditionally adds or removes classes from an object map, or no-ops for nullish input.
- `setHTML(html: string | null | undefined, unsafe?: boolean): this` — Sets the inner HTML of the Element.
- `setShadow(mode: ShadowRootMode): this` — Attaches a Shadow DOM to the Element if it's not already attached.
- `setText(text?: unknown): this` — Sets the text content of the Element.
- `shadow(mode: ShadowRootMode): JJSR` — Attaches a Shadow DOM if needed and returns the wrapped shadow root.
- `show(): this` — Shows the Element by removing the `hidden` and `aria-hidden` attributes.
- `swAttr(name: string, ...force: [boolean?]): this` — Conditionally sets or removes a boolean-style (presence-based) attribute, or auto-toggles it when called without a `force` value.
- `swClass(className: string, ...force: [boolean?]): this` — Conditionally adds or removes a single class, or auto-toggles it when called without a `force` value.
- `static from(ref: Element): JJE` — Creates a JJE instance from an Element reference.

Inherited members (see the declaring class for signatures):

- from `JJNx`: ref: T, addChild, addChildMap<T>, addChildren, addTemplate, addText, clone, empty, find<W extends JJE<Element> = JJHE<HTMLElement>>, findAll<W extends JJE<Element> = JJHE<HTMLElement>>, getChildren, getParent, getParentNode, off, on, preChild, preChildMap<T>, preChildren, rm, run, setChild, setChildMap<T>, setChildren, setTemplate, swChild, trigger, triggerCustomEvent<T = unknown>, triggerEvent

### `JJET`

Wraps a DOM EventTarget.

Members declared on this class:

- `ref: T` (read-only)
- `off(eventName: string, handler: EventListenerOrEventListenerObject | null, options?: boolean | EventListenerOptions): this` — Removes an event listener.
- `on(eventName: string, handler: EventListenerOrEventListenerObject | null, options?: AddEventListenerOptions): this` — Adds an event listener.
- `run(fn: __type(this: this, jjContext: this): void): this` — Runs a function in the context of this JJET instance.
- `trigger(event: Event): this` — Dispatches an Event at the specified EventTarget.
- `triggerCustomEvent<T = unknown>(type: string, detail?: T, options?: Omit<CustomEventInit<T>, "detail">): this` — Creates a new `CustomEvent` and dispatches on the wrapped target.
- `triggerEvent(type: string, options?: EventInit): this` — Creates a new `Event` and dispatches on the wrapped target.
- `static from(ref: EventTarget): JJET<EventTarget>` — Creates a JJET instance from an EventTarget reference.

## Types

### `Wrappable`

- `type Wrappable = string | number | boolean | bigint | symbol | object | null | undefined | Node | JJN` — Represents any value that can be wrapped by the library.

## Functions

### `attr2prop`

- `attr2prop(instance: HTMLElement, name: string, oldValue: unknown, newValue: unknown): boolean` — A helper to bridge the attribute world (kebab-case) to the property world (camelCase).

### `defineComponent`

- `defineComponent(name: string, constructor: CustomElementConstructor, options?: ElementDefinitionOptions): Promise<boolean>` — Registers the custom element with the browser and waits till it is defined.

### `fetchStyle`

- `fetchStyle(url: string | URL): Promise<CSSStyleSheet>` — Fetches a CSS file and constructs a CSSStyleSheet.

### `fetchTemplate`

- `fetchTemplate(url: string | URL): Promise<JJDF<DocumentFragment>>` — Fetches an HTML template and returns it as a wrapped `DocumentFragment`.
